questions.question: A sum of Rs. 12,000 amounts to Rs. 20,736 in 1(1)/(2) years at a certain rate per annum on compound interest, compounded half yearly. What will be the compound interest (in Rs.) of the same sum in 2 years at the same rate on compound interest. If the interest is compounded annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sum = Rs. 12,000, Amount = Rs. 20,736

Time = 1(1)/(2) years, Compounded half yearly

**Formula Used:**

CI = A – P

A = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ

Where CI = compound interest, A = amount

P = sum/principle, R = rate, n = number of years

**Calculation:**

Time = 1(1)/(2) years = 3/2 years

Compounded half-yearly i.e. Twice a year

⇒ Time = 3/2 × 2 = 3

A = P(1 + R/100)n

⇒ 20,736 = 12,000(1 + R/100)³

⇒ (1 + R/100)³ = 20,736/12,000 

⇒ (1 + R/100)³ = 216/125

Taking cube root on both sides, we get

⇒ 1 + R/100 = 6/5

⇒ R = 20% 

Rate when compounded yearly = 20 × 2

⇒ Rate = 40% and Time = 2 years

Compound interest when compounded yearly,

A = P(1 + R/100)n

⇒ A = 12,000 (1 + 40/100)²

⇒ A = 12,000 (1 + 4/10)²

⇒ A = 12,000 × 14/10 × 14/10 = 23,520

Now for compound interest,

⇒ CI = 23,520 – 12,000 = 11,520 

**∴ Compound interest, when compounded annually, is Rs. 11,520.**

questions.question: A sum of money was put at simple interest at a certain rate for 2 years. Had it been at 3% higher rate for 3 years, it would have fetched Rs. 72 more. If the sum is 80 times the rate of interest, then the rate per annum is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The sum is 80 times the rate of interest

Time = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × T × R)/100

Where SI = Simple interest, P = principle

T = time, R = rate of interest

**Calculation:**

Let the rate of interest be x

⇒ Sum = 80 × x = 80x

Now Simple interest,

SI₁ = (80x × x × 2)/100 = 8x²/5

According to the question,

The rate of interest = (x + 3)%

And Time = 3 years

⇒ SI₂ = {80x × (x + 3) × 3}/100 = {12x(x + 3)}/5

Then it would have fetched Rs. 72 more

SI2 – SI1 = 72

⇒ {12x(x + 3)}/5 – 8x2/5 = 72

⇒ (12x2 + 36x – 8x2)/5 = 72

⇒ 4x² + 36x = 72 × 5

⇒ 4x2 + 36x – 360 = 0

⇒ x2 + 9x – 90 = 0

⇒ x(x + 15) – 6(x + 15) = 0

⇒ (x – 6) (x + 15) = 0

⇒ x = 6 or x = –15

Rate can not be negative so, rate = 6%

**∴Hence the Rate of interest is 6%.**

questions.question: The average of 17 numbers is 15. If the average of the first nine numbers is 14 and that of the last 9 numbers is 16, then the middle number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 17 number = 15.

Average of first 9 numbers = 14.

Average of last 9 numbers = 16.

**Formula Used:**

Average = Sum of all observations/Total number of observations

**Calculation:**

Sum of all 17 numbers/17 = 15 

⇒ Sum of all 17 numbers = 15 × 17 = 255

Similarly For the first and last 9 numbers,

⇒ Sum of first 9 numbers = 14 × 9 = 126

⇒ Sum of last 9 numbers = 16 × 9 = 144

Sum of first 9 number + Sum of last 9 number

⇒ Sum of total 18 numbers

I.e. Middle number is added twice

Middle number = Sum of 18 numbers – Sum of 17 numbers

Middle number = (126 + 144) – 255 = 15

**∴ The middle number is 15**.

questions.question: The arrangement off rational numbers - (7)/({10)}, - (5)/({8)}, - (2)/({3)} in descending order is:
4 bells ring at an interval of 4, 12, 20 and 25 minutes. If they ring together at 8 a.m. then at what time they will ring together?.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

4 bells Ring at an interval of 4, 12, 20, and 25 minutes.

They ring together at 8 a.m.

**Concept used:**

LCM method

**Calculation:**

4 = 2 × 2 and 12 = 2 × 2 × 3

20 = 2 × 2 × 5 and 25 = 5 × 5

∴ LCM of 4, 12, 20 and 25 = 2 × 2 × 3 × 5 × 5

⇒ 300 minutes = 5 hour

So, 8 a.m. + 5 hour = 13 p.m. = 1 p.m.

**∴ They will Ring together again at 1 p.m.**

questions.question: A towel, when bleached, was found to have lost 25% of its length and 15% of its breadth. The percentage of decrease in the ares is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let the Length = 10, breadth = 10, Area = 100

New Length = 10 - 2.5 = 7.5

New Breadth = 10 - 1.5 = 8.5

New area = 7.5 × 8.5 = 63.75

Change (in percentage) = 100 - 63.75 = 36.25

∴ The percentage decrease is 36.25.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Change in length = 25%, Change in breadth = 15%

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = length × breadth

Percentage decrease = (Change in area/original area) × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the length be x and breadth be y

∴ Area = xy

New length = 75x/100 = 3x/4

New breadth = 85y/100 = 17y/20

New area = 51xy/80

Change in area = xy - (51xy/80) = 29xy/80

Percentage change = [(29xy/80)/xy] × 100

⇒ (29 × 5)/4 = 145/4 = 36.25

**∴ The percentage decrease is 36.25.**

**Concept used:**

Perimeter of a triangle = a + b + c

Here, a, b and c are the sides of the triangle

**Calculation:**

L.C.M of 2, 3, 5 = 30

Ratio of sides = 30 × 1/2 : 30 × 1/3 : 30 × 1/5

⇒ 15 : 10 : 6

According to the question

31 → 186 cm

⇒ 1 → 6 cm

⇒ 15 → 90 cm

⇒ largest side = 90 cm

**∴ Length of the largest side is 90 cm**

questions.question: A housewife spends 60% of her monthly income on grocery, clothes and education in the ratio of 5 ∶ 7 ∶ 10, respectively. If the amount spent on grocery is Rs. 15,000 then what is her monthly income (in Rs.)?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

Ratio of expenditure on grocery, clothes and education = 5 : 7 : 10 

Percentage of expenditure of monthly income = 60% 

Amount spent on grocery = Rs. 15,000 

**Calculation: **

Let the amount spend on grocery, clothes and education be ‘5x’, ‘7x’ and ‘10x’ 

⇒ Total expenditure = 5x + 7x + 10x = 22x

According to the question, 

⇒ 5x = 15000 

⇒ x = 3000 

⇒ Total expenditure = 22 × 3000 = Rs. 66,000 

Also, this is 60% of her total income 

⇒ 60% of Income = 66000 

⇒ 60/100 × Income = 66000 

⇒ Income = 66000 × 100/60 

⇒ Income = Rs. 1,10,000 

**∴**** Her monthly income is Rs. 1,10,000**

questions.question: By selling a sofa set for Rs. 25,800 and a table for Rs. 5,000, a shopkeeper gains 10% on the whole transaction. However, if he sells the sofa set for Rs. 22,500 and the table for its original cost, he loses 5%. What is the original cost of the table?
questions.solution:
**Given: **

SP of sofa set for 1st transaction = Rs. 25,800

SP of table for 1st transaction = Rs. 5,000

Gain in 1st transaction = 10%

SP of sofa set in 2ⁿd transaction = Rs. 22,500

SP of table for 2ⁿd transaction = CP

Loss in 2ⁿd transaction = 5%

**Formula used: **

Profit = SP – CP

Loss = CP – SP

Profit % = (SP – CP)/CP × 100

Loss % = (CP – SP)/CP × 100

**Calculation: **

Total SP in 1st transaction = SP of sofa set + SP of table

⇒ Total SP in 1st transaction = 25800 + 5000

⇒ Total SP in 1st transaction = 30800

Profit % = (SP – CP)/CP × 100

⇒ 10 = (30800 – CP)/CP × 100

⇒ CP = (30800 – CP)10

⇒ CP = 308000 – 10CP

⇒ 11CP = 308000

⇒ CP = 28000

Total CP = Rs. 28,000

Loss = 5% of 28000

⇒ Loss = 5/100 × 28000 = 1400

As, table is sold at cost price in 2ⁿd transaction

CP of sofa set = 22500 + 1400 = 23900

CP of table = Total CP – CP of sofa set

⇒ CP of table = 28000 – 23900

⇒ CP of table = 4100

**∴**** Cost price of table is Rs. 4100 **
